G214.b:

(< ἀληθής), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨אֱמֶת⁩ (on which, v. Cremer, 627f.), ⁨אֱמוּנָה⁩;] ⟪truth⟫ (v. DB, iv, 818f.).

⟪2.⟫ Subjectively, ⟪truthfulness, truth⟫, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: ⟦John 8:44|Jo 8:44⟧, ⟦3 John 1:3|III Jo 3⟧.
⟪3.⟫ In phrases (MM, VGT, s.v.): ἐπ’ ἀληθείας, ⟦Mark 12:14|Mk 12:14⟧, al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), ⟦Romans 9:1|Ro 9:1⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 12:6|II Co 12:6⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:25|Eph 4:25⟧, al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν, ⟦John 3:21|Jo 3:21⟧, ⟦1 John 1:6|I Jo 1:6⟧ (cf. DB, iv, 818b, ff.).

(acc. to Plut., < ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness), [in LXX: ⟦Exodus 28:19|Ex 28:19⟧ ⟦Exodus 36:19|36:19⟧ ⟦Exodus 39:12|39:12⟧ ⟦Ezekiel 28:13|Ez 28:13⟧*;] ⟪amethyst⟫, a purple quartz: ⟦Revelation 21:20|Re 21:20⟧.†

G272.b:
⟪ἀμελέω⟫, -ῶ
(< μέλει), [in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 4:17|Je 4:17⟧ (⁨מרה⁩) ⟦Jeremiah 31:32|Je 31:32⟧ (⁨בּעל⁩), Wi 3:10, II Mac 4:14*;]
⟪(a)⟫ absol., ⟪to be careless⟫, ⟪not to care⟫: ⟦Matthew 22:5|Mt 22:5⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ c. gen., ⟪to be careless of⟫, ⟪to neglect⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 4:14|I Ti 4:14⟧, ⟦Hebrews 2:3|He 2:3⟧ ⟦Hebrews 8:9|8:9⟧ (v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G273.b:
⟪ἄ-μεμπτος⟫, -ον
(< μέμφομσι), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨תָּם⁩;] ⟪blameless⟫, ⟪free from fault⟫ (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, ⟦1 Thessalonians 3:13|Th., I, 3:13⟧; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦Luke 1:6|Lk 1:6⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:15|Phl 2:15⟧ ⟦Philippians 3:6|3:6⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 3:13|I Th 3:13⟧ (WH, mg., -ως) ⟦Hebrews 8:7|He 8:7⟧.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, q.v. (Tr., Syn., § ciii).

G274.b:

G275.b:

G276.b:

G279.b:

G280.b:

G281.b:

[in LXX: ⟦1 Chronicles 16:36|I Ch 16:36⟧, I Es 9:46, ⟦Nehemiah 5:13|Ne 5:13⟧ ⟦Nehemiah 8:6|8:6⟧, To 8:8 14:15, III Mac 7:23, IV Mac 18:24 (elsewhere ⁨א״⁩ is rendered ἀληθινός, ⟦Isaiah 65:16|Is 65:16⟧; ἀληθῶς, Je 35 (28):6; γένοιτο, ⟦Numbers 5:22|Nu 5:22⟧, ⟦Deuteronomy 27:15|De 27:15⟧ff., ⟦1 Kings 1:36|III Ki 1:36⟧, Ps 40 (41):13 71 (72):19 105 (106):48, ⟦Jeremiah 11:5|Je 11:5⟧)*.]
⟪1.⟫ As adj. (cf. ⟦Isaiah 65:16|Is 65:16⟧), ὁ ἀ., ⟦Revelation 3:14|Re 3:14⟧.
⟪2.⟫ As adv.,
	⟪(a)⟫ in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another (⟦Numbers 5:22|Nu 5:22⟧, ⟦Nehemiah 5:13|Ne 5:13⟧ ⟦Nehemiah 8:6|8:6⟧ etc.): ὁ ἀ., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:16|I Co 14:16⟧;
	⟪(b)⟫ similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise: ⟦Romans 1:25|Ro 1:25⟧ ⟦Romans 15:33|15:33⟧, ⟦Galatians 1:5|Ga 1:5⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 1:17|I Ti 1:17⟧;
	⟪(c)⟫ in the Gospels, exclusively, introducing solemn statements of our Lord, ⟪truly⟫, ⟪verily⟫: ⟦Matthew 5:18|Mt 5:18⟧, ⟦Matthew 5:26|26⟧ ⟦Mark 3:28|Mk 3:28⟧ (v. Swete, in l.), ⟦Luke 4:24|Lk 4:24⟧, al.; ἀ. ἀ., always in ⟦John 1:52|Jo 1:52⟧ ⟦John 3:3|3:3⟧ ⟦John 5:19|5:19⟧, al.; τὸ ναί, καὶ . . . τὸ ἀ., ⟦2 Corinthians 1:20|II Co 1:20⟧ (on usage in π., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).
a: Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906

G282.b:

G288.b:

G289.b:
⟪ἀμπελουργός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ,

G290.b:
⟪ἀμπελών⟫, -ῶνος, ὁ
(< ἄμπελος), [in LXX for ⁨כֶּרֶם⁩;] ⟪a vineyard⟫: ⟦Matthew 20:1|Mt 20:1⟧ ff. ⟦Matthew 21:28|Mt 21:28⟧ ff, ⟦Luke 13:6|Lk 13:6⟧ ⟦Luke 20:9|20:9⟧ ff., ⟦1 Corinthians 9:7|I Co 9:7⟧. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.; LS, s.v. ἀμπελουργεῖον.)

G293.b:
⟪ἀμφίβληστρον⟫, -ου, τό

G296.b:
⟪ἄμφοδον⟫, -ου, το
